sample_description: Ti-Ni-O nanotube arrays grown by pulse anodization (4000 Hz, 50 % duty cycle, 180 min) of Ti-Ni shape-memory alloy (Ti:Ni = 1:1) in 5 % ethylene glycol/glycerol with 0.30 M (NH4)2SO4 + NH4F; anodized at 30, 40 and 50 V pulse voltage; anatase + rutile + titanate after annealing
notes: paper: peak 'corresponded to the anatase phase' (no symmetry given); positions stated jointly for the 30, 40 and 50 V samples (also printed on Fig. 5); rutile 244/437/607 and titanate 288 cm-1 skipped; the paper attributes the shift from 144/399 to Ni doping
